shellCommands.command: cat package.json; ls; ls app src 2>/dev/null; git status --short; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/; grep -rl "cookies" node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | grep -iE 'cookies|headers' | head

cat app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx next.config.ts; ls __agent_eval__; sed -n 1,80p node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cookies.md; sed -n 1,60p node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/headers.md
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; echo tsc=$?; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -20

(npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/n.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s localhost:3123 | grep -o 'Current theme.*language: <strong>[^<]*' ; echo; curl -s -H 'Cookie: theme=dark' -H 'Accept-Language: fr-CH, fr;q=0.9, en;q=0.8' localhost:3123 | grep -o 'Current theme.*language: <strong>[^<]*'; pkill -f "next start" ; true

curl -s localhost:3123 | grep -o 'Current theme.*language: <strong>[^<]*' ; echo; curl -s -H 'Cookie: theme=dark' -H 'Accept-Language: fr-CH, fr;q=0.9, en;q=0.8' localhost:3123 | grep -o 'Current theme.*language: <strong>[^<]*'
